notes: Anthropology of the burial caves excavated by Shurkin ('Atiqot 48, not in this reader's units). Caves C, E, F, G, H (kokhim, shelves, collecting pits, enclosures; eight ossuaries in Cave F) with Second Temple material; Cave J with EB IV/MB I material, excluded from the sample by the author. Tombs coded as the remains' context (choice C2).
